limitations: Generic Hyper-V and arbitrary hypervisor state are not inferred from VMCALL/VMMCALL
The bound service depends only on the five ABI inputs and mapped RAM, returns normally, and preserves the rest of the represented state and compiler environment
No new exception, TF/RF, asynchronous-event, RTM or caller-context domain
NeverC frontend and NeverD source are x64; code32 qualification belongs to the full LLVM fork
Final LLVM SDK release and pin remain pending completion of the wider x86 task
